objective: Use ChatGPT Deep Research freely for RBB gap closure and discovery while minimizing unnecessary calls; preserve Codex and Work capacity only when those surfaces are actually engaged.

execution_order.rule: Always perform before any model or web-research call.
Preferred research engine when available; batch related gaps and targets into the fewest bounded calls.
Use only after deterministic work and reuse the deep-research result rather than repeating its searches.

use_for: schema failure that cheaper tiers cannot repair
execution_order.rule: Exception only; record the escalation reason and do not repeat work already completed by a cheaper tier.

capacity_scope.chatgpt_deep_research: No known Chat-specific usage limit is currently observable. Do not apply Codex or Work limits to Chat research cycles.
capacity_scope.codex_or_work: Apply the capacity gate only when a cycle requires Codex or Work execution.
capacity_scope.future_chat_limit: If a real Chat-specific limit becomes observable, add a separate gate based only on that limit; do not infer one from Codex or Work.

batch_rule: Calling functions determine Chat research cycle size. Recommended sizes improve focus and call efficiency but are not capacity gates.
